reference_answer: The chapter focuses on Pakistan’s population, labour force and employment. It discusses rapid population growth and its pressure on public services, demographic and age structure, population patterns, family planning, gender parity, skills and employment initiatives, and overseas employment. It frames population growth as a challenge but says education, healthcare, skills and well-managed demographic change can support development. (Physical PDF pages 1–3 and 15.)
